justification: Policy v1_max36_25pct_cap120 on the HMI x SPY overlap (393 months, 1993-02..2025-10 SPY-return-bound; HMI history extends to 1985-01 but SPY inception caps the pair). span = min(max(36, round(393*0.25)), 120) = 98 months (~8.2 years) — ABOVE the 5-year reliability floor, a LONG OOS window by fleet standards. OOS 2017-09-30..2025-10-31 spans late-cycle 2018 vol, COVID, the 2021 housing boom, the 2022 rate shock (HMI 83->31) and the 2023-25 high-rate regime. IS = 295 months covering the 1990s expansion, dot-com bust, the classic 2005-09 housing-leads-the-cycle episode, and the QE era. No structural-break exclusion applied; break diagnostics reported separately (structural_break json + era_correlations.csv).
